character: 老周（父亲）— 疲惫隐忍
description: Old Zhou (father), 56 years old. Same as base: dark blue work jacket, gray cotton trousers, slightly hunched posture, lean stocky build with chronic lower back tension.
scene: Immediately after lifting his daughter from bed to wheelchair. Morning light, dim and muted.
clothing: Dark blue work jacket, gray cotton trousers, dark slippers.
actions: Standing bent over after exertion, right hand slowly moving to press his lower back. Breathing heavily through slightly parted lips.

angles.front: Face showing exhaustion beyond physical strain. Eyes half-lidded but not sleeping. A quiet endurance.
angles.side: Profile showing his hand pressed against his lumbar spine, fingers digging slightly into the muscle.
angles.three_quarter: From slightly above and front, showing the complete curve of his exhausted posture.

expression: Tired and resigned — heavy eyelids, slight frown, mouth closed and pressed. A weariness that goes beyond physical fatigue.
lighting: Dim warm morning light, shadows under his eyes and brow. Low contrast.
note: This expression is the default state for Old Zhou in early scenes.
